title: Split Open bands
description: bands.yaml: who plays which stem for each band, keyed by the band slug a song names in songs.yaml. See README.md.

name.description: The band's name, shown in the venue line under the song title.

short_name.description: Stands in for the name where space is tight (TTB, WSP).

channels.description: The stems this band has, each with who plays it and what. A band lists only the stems it has: a string band leaves out keys and drums, a band with a horn section adds horns.

who.description: The player's name, as the fader is labelled.

inst.description: The instrument, shown under the name.
